ai_summary: Atal Realtech Limited's Board has approved a Rights Issue to raise up to Rs. 16 crore by offering new equity shares to eligible existing shareholders. This fund-raising initiative aims to bolster the company's capital, offering shareholders an opportunity to maintain their proportional ownership, while those not participating will experience dilution. No immediate red flags are apparent from this announcement, but the detailed terms and intended use of funds are yet to be disclosed.
